description: Abstract PHP class 'NormalizableDTO' defining methods for normalizing data structures into arrays, including methods for applying getter mappings and recursive normalization of iterable data.

classes.name: NormalizableDTO
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for normalizing data objects into array formats with customizable getter mappings.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Abstract method to convert specified fields to an array representation.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the mapping of fields to their respective getter methods.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes iterable data into an array where each field contains an array of corresponding values, using getter mappings.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Calls the appropriate getter methods on an item to retrieve a value, supporting nested method calls.
